title: AVD Infrastructure 3
description: Ops pages VDI: nobody can connect to one specific Multi-Session host pool. Reports name that pool.
scope: Out-of-hours Ops callout. Connect failures reported against one AVD Multi-Session host pool.
illustrativeDisclaimer: This scenario, its mock incident, runbook titles, product names, escalation routes, and organisational procedures are illustrative. Validate them against approved operational sources before use. They are not bank-specific policy.
assessorGuidance: Reward scoping to one Multi-Session host pool before touching the estate. Azure status first. INC before any work. Compare this pool with other Multi-Session pools and Personal. If manual provisioning or spin-up of a host in that pool fails, Microsoft SevA. TRM if the user base on that pool is severe; Ops can call TRM too. Recovery: live users of that pool on the bridge, plus Azure workbooks for active connections on that pool. Safety-critical: do not go in as Contributor and mass-turn on / drain / rebuild that pool, or make unofficial changes, with no INC or CR.
acceptableAlternativeApproaches: Azure status and INC first, then confirm other host pools still connect, then a single test spin-up on the affected pool.
TRM on because that pool’s business unit cannot work, while VDI proves the blast radius.
Ops call TRM while VDI compares pools and decides whether Microsoft is needed.

questions.prompt: Walk through how you would handle this incident from the first call through to recovery. Write the full response in your own words.
questions.helpText: One pool is being reported. Think about blast radius, and what you would not do without cover.
questions.assessorGuidance: Score the whole write-up. Reward: Azure status first; INC before work; this pool versus other Multi-Session and Personal; Microsoft SevA if provision/spin-up fails; TRM when that pool’s impact is severe; recovery via users of that pool on the bridge and workbooks. Do not score as demonstrated: Contributor mass power-on or drain of that pool with no INC/CR; treating every host pool as down because one is; skipping Microsoft when Azure status or spin-up has already failed.

scoringCriteria.label: Checks Azure status first, keeps an INC on the record, and proves this Multi-Session pool versus other pools before changing anything
Treats a single Multi-Session host pool as the blast radius until other pools and Personal are checked
Raises Microsoft SevA when provision or spin-up on that pool fails, and treats an MS outage as a smoking gun
Uses TRM when that pool’s user impact is severe; Ops may call TRM too
Confirms recovery with live users of that pool on the bridge and Azure workbooks for active connections
Does not mass-start, drain, or rebuild that pool as Contributor without INC and CR
